leadText:
Melvin (Japanese: マギー McGee) is a character of the day who appeared in The March of the Exeggutor Squad. He is a struggling magician who always had bad luck. His dream is to get to perform at (changed to in the English dub).

When ran into him at a carnival in Kanto, his assistant had just quit on him. Feeling bad for him, Misty became his new assistant, but it didn't improve his magic show.

When was questioning Melvin about what good his was, they used on him, putting him under Melvin's control. He had Ash weaken a group of , which Melvin proceeded to capture. He planned to use them to hypnotize everybody at the carnival into attending his show.

However, after his own Exeggcute evolved into Exeggutor, it hypnotized the other Exeggutor into stampeding throughout the carnival, destroying everything in sight. Melvin didn't know what to do, but with the help of Misty and Ash's Charmander, he was able to create his own fire to snap the Exeggutor out of their hypnosis and return everything back to normal.
